notes.title: Invirium Demo @ Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Get inside the human body during Steam Next Fest![/b]
Invirium demo will be available on the 16th - 22nd of June.

You'll be able to play with Neutrophil through the first section of the game and try to take out Rotavirus at the end. Grasp the basics of Invirium before playing the full game!

Feel invited to download a demo, play, and share your thoughts with us via Steam, social media, or Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/s4gP8hU4Fm]https://discord.gg/s4gP8hU4Fm[/url] 

[b]Add Invirium to your Wishlist not to miss the demo when it drops![/b]

notes.title: Combining the attacks
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Let's have a look for a combos in the Invirium. There is simple and addictive way of make more interesting fights inside pathogenic world. Each character has own unique combo you can try. Combo attack follows every shot every 2 quick dashes occurring right after each other.

Neutrophil character fires deadly shotgun-like projeticles ideal for fast room clearing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39713465/883e479f6b032524882da8539d1456f0de033d5b.gif[/img]

The other combo is the basophil's vortex root effect. Affected projectile launches this powerful force which brings enemies in range to one spot. You can use vortex root to inflict more crowd control during fights.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39713465/bcf699fe6b5f524d8a53a07d50036b3157c5a5a0.gif[/img]

Stay tuned and vaccinated!

notes.title: Phagocytosis
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today we will look closer at the unique Invirium game mechanic called [b]phagocytosis[/b]. As you could preassumpt it should behave like real mechanisms of the innate immune defense. In fact it is complex process so let's look on the actual in-game action.

Professional phagocyte, in our case, we can look at the nature of the Neutrophil character. It has the passive ability to remove pathogens. In simple terms - get closer to your enemy to eat one, but watch out for the cooldown time before you eat another! Each time phagocytosis is done, our character will develop more base HP. Those additional health points have different values depending on the difficulty of the eaten enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39713465/7d4619cb1d0af3ff57bf9f916bc7fd185397704e.gif[/img]

You should take a little care because even with its high value, this ability has a cons too. When you try to eat a bacteria, it could end up you're literally pushed to death..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39713465/713e67cdfae46e2f2ea44b0eab92fbb17a87b401.gif[/img]

Stay tuned and vaccinated!

notes.title: Hepatovirus
notes.content:
Our researches found out that "Hepatovirus A" is located in the body. Attacking the digestive system, hinders liver function. Causes a disease called "Jaundice". This condition is caused by too much bilirubin in the blood and because of that the skin, whites of the eyes and mucous membranes turn yellow. We are fighting with it...
We faced various enemies in liver
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39713465/cc6b1a702667820cbe72b00f5744159c930659c9.png[/img]
and hepatovirus

notes.title: Welcome to the Invirium world!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Be ready to plunge into the exciting world of Invirium very soon. We are a small team but focused on development based on constructive feedback. This is what we believe will help to create a great game and community. While you are taking a break from enjoying the screenshots, we work hard to bring you hours of unforgettable gameplay. We assure you, viruses are not just a problem in the real world.
